title: Truchas 2D vector function
description: A vector-function value accepted by the parameter-list-driven vector-function factory. This includes direct numeric vectors and inline parameter-list forms; function-table name references and lower-level function-pointer constructors are not included.

number-array.description: A non-empty array of real numbers.

constant.title: Constant vector function
constant.description: A vector function with the same vector value for every input.

value.description: The constant vector value. A consuming 2D model may require a particular number of components.

tabular.title: Tabular vector function
tabular.description: A vector function defined by tabular input coordinates and vector values, with linear interpolation.

tabular-x.description: At least two tabular coordinates for the selected input argument. The number of entries must match the outer-array length of tabular-y.

items.description: Vector value at one tabular coordinate. The inner-array length is the number of vector components.

tabular-y.description: Vector values at the tabular coordinates. The outer array is indexed by tabular point; each inner array contains the vector components.

tabular-arg.description: One-based index of the input coordinate used for table lookup.

polynomial.title: Polynomial vector function
polynomial.description: A vector-valued multivariable polynomial. In the notation F_k(x) = sum_j c_kj product_i (x_i - x0_i)^(a_ij), k identifies an output component, i identifies an input variable, and j identifies a polynomial term.

items.description: Coefficients c_kj for one polynomial term j, one per output component k.

poly-coef.description: The outer array is indexed by term j; each inner array is indexed by output component k. The number of inner arrays must match poly-powers, and all inner arrays must have the same length.

items.description: Exponents a_ij for one polynomial term j, one per input variable i.

poly-powers.description: The outer array is indexed by term j; each inner array is indexed by input variable i. The number of inner arrays must match the outer-array length of poly-coef, and all inner arrays must have the same length.

poly-center.description: Reference point x0_i indexed by input variable i. The default is zero for every input variable.

div-radial-cyl-flow.title: Divergence-free radial cylindrical flow
div-radial-cyl-flow.description: A built-in three-component divergence-free radial cylindrical flow function. It is not compatible with the 2D VOF velocity requirement, which requires a two-component vector.

type.description: Selects the built-in radial cylindrical flow form.

axis.description: Three-component vector defining the cylinder axis.

library.title: Dynamically loaded vector function
library.description: A vector function implemented by a symbol loaded from a shared library. This form requires an executable configured with dynamic-loading support.

type.description: Selects the dynamically loaded function form.

library-path.description: Path to the shared library containing the function symbol.

library-symbol.description: Name of the library symbol implementing the vector function.

dimension.description: Number of components in the vector returned by the library function.

parameters.description: Optional real parameters passed to the library function.

vector-function-value.description: A vector-function value accepted by a parameter resolved through the vector-function factory. A direct numeric array is a constant vector; an object defines an inline vector function.
